newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia pledges aid for Iran earthquake victims.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia pledges aid for Iran earthquake victims.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad has pledged to provide humanitarian aid to victims of the major earthquake in Iran, the official Bernama news agency reported on Tuesday.
"We'll send aid as usual, but we have not determined the amount yet," Bernama quoted Mahathir as telling reporters in parliament.
Iran said on Tuesday that 1,560 people were killed and 2,810 injured in Saturday's earthquake, which measured 7.1 on the Richter scale and struck near its eastern border.
A smaller earthquake jolted the same region on Tuesday but there was no word on casualties.
The government has put initial damage estimates from Saturday's earthquake at $100 million.
